commands.name: GetVersion
commands.description: Version of this script.

commands.name: Help
commands.description: Comma separated command names, or the usage of one command.

commands.name: Describe
commands.description: JSON on one line. No argument: protocol version, script version, instrument, transport, features, detectors. commands: every command definition (use TCP: this is several kB).

commands.name: Ping
commands.description: Check that the server is answering.

commands.name: KeepAlive
commands.description: TCP only, and only as the first command on a connection: keep the connection open. Commands end in CR, LF or CRLF; replies end in LF.

commands.name: GetTuningSettingsList
commands.description: Saved tune settings.

commands.name: SetTuningSettings
commands.description: Load a saved tune setting.

commands.name: GetIntegrationTime
commands.description: Integration time of the monitor scan.

commands.name: SetIntegrationTime
commands.description: Restart the monitor scan with a new integration time.

commands.name: BlankBeam
commands.description: true remembers Y-Symmetry and sets it to -50, false restores it. Does nothing when Config.use_beam_blank is false.

commands.name: GetData
commands.description: Latest scan. Name,value pairs when Config.tag_data is true, values only when false. "Error: no data" before the first scan.

commands.name: GetDataN
commands.description: Latest scan with its scan count, which goes up by one for every scan. <data> is as for GetData.

commands.name: GetNextData
commands.description: Wait for a scan newer than <scan count> (default: the latest scan now). Timeout defaults to 5 s. Over UDP this holds up other commands while it waits.

commands.name: Subscribe
commands.description: TCP only: the server writes one line per scan until the client disconnects. Allowed as the first command or after KeepAlive.

commands.name: ProbeScanData
commands.description: Diagnostic: log the structure of the next scan to the Qtegra log.

commands.name: GetCupConfigurationList
commands.description: Cup configuration names, separated by carriage returns.

commands.name: GetSubCupConfigurationList
commands.description: Sub cup configuration names of a cup configuration.

commands.name: GetSubCupParameters
commands.description: parameter,value;parameter,value...: the deflection of each detector of the selected instrument, then CDD Supply Set. Unreadable parameters are left out.

commands.name: ActivateCupConfiguration
commands.description: Names cannot contain spaces.

commands.name: ActivateIonCounter
commands.description: Activate and unprotect one CDD, then restart the monitor scan.

commands.name: DeactivateIonCounter
commands.description: Deactivate and protect one CDD, then restart the monitor scan.

commands.name: ActivateAllCDDs
commands.description: Activate and unprotect every CDD with a mass in the active cup configuration.

commands.name: DeactivateAllCDDs
commands.description: Deactivate and protect all CDDs.

commands.name: Open
commands.description: Set the valve parameter to 1, e.g. Open Valve Ion Pump Set.

commands.name: Close
commands.description: Set the valve parameter to 0.

commands.name: GetValveState
commands.description: True when open.

commands.name: GetMagnetDAC
commands.description: Field Set, 0-10 V.

commands.name: SetMagnetDAC
commands.description: Set Field Set, 0-10 V. Moves larger than Config.magnet_move_threshold are stepped in the background: poll GetMagnetMoving.

commands.name: GetMagnetMoving
commands.description: True while a SetMagnetDAC or SetMass move is running.

commands.name: SetMass
commands.description: Put <mass> on <cup> (default AX). Deactivates the CDDs first; large moves are stepped.

commands.name: GetHighVoltage
commands.description: Acceleration Reference Set in V.

commands.name: GetHV
commands.description: Acceleration Reference Set in kV. Note: SetHV takes V.

commands.name: SetHV
commands.description: Same as SetHighVoltage. Note: takes V although GetHV returns kV.

commands.name: ProtectDetector
commands.description: On saves the deflection and sets it to 2000, Off restores it.

commands.name: GetDeflection
commands.description: Deflection <detector> Set.

commands.name: GetDeflections
commands.description: 0 for a deflection that cannot be read.

commands.name: GetIonCounterVoltage
commands.description: CDD Supply Set.

commands.name: GetGain
commands.description: Detector gain from the calibration data.

commands.name: GetParameter
commands.description: Any item in the instrument's hardware database, e.g. Field Set. See "Finding parameter names".

commands.name: GetParameters
commands.description: 0 for a parameter that cannot be read: use CheckParameters to tell.

commands.name: CheckParameters
commands.description: True for each parameter that can be read.

commands.name: ProbeInstrument
commands.description: Diagnostic: log the instrument object's properties and members to the Qtegra log, to look for a list of its parameters.
